errors.what: First patch-html attempt used flag-style args (--action/--selector/--fragment); CLI rejected them
errors.recovered_by: Read patch-html --help and agent-help; authored a patch file with YAML frontmatter (mode/patch_selector/patch_action) and passed it as HTML_FILE arg

problems_and_friction: patch-html takes a frontmatter patch file, not inline flags, so the first invocation failed; agent-help clarified the exact schema and the retry succeeded. Validation printed OK and the snapshot was taken cleanly.
context_understood: Zoho is now cheapest, so its chart bar must shrink to y=78 height=82 via a single patch-html replace of the #bar-zoho rect.
